import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Queue;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 15;
    static final int M = 100005;
    static final int INF = (int) 1e9;
    static final int[] x = { 0, 0, -1, 1 };
    static final int[] y = { 1, -1, 0, 0 };
    static char[][] c = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] S = new char[N][N];
    static int sx, sy, st, ed, n, t, tot, id[][] = new int[N][N], dis[][] = new int[N][N], vis[][] = new int[N][N];
    static int[] dist = new int[N * N * 2];
    static int k1 = 1;
    static class Bian {
        int ed, before, flow;

        public Bian(int ed, int before, int flow) {
            this.ed = ed;
            this.before = before;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }
    static Bian[] s = new Bian[M];
    static int[][] Dis = new int[N][N];
    static class Node {
        int x, y;

        public Node(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }
    static Node[] Q = new Node[100005];

    static boolean check(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n || vis[x][y] || c[x][y] < '0' || c[x][y] > '9') return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void Bfs() {
        int i, l = 1, r = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                dis[i][j] = 60;
            }
        }
        dis[sx][sy] = 0;
        Q[r++] = new Node(sx, sy);
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;
        while (l <= r) {
            Node p = Q[l++];
            for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                if (check(p.x + x[i], p.y + y[i])) {
                    dis[p.x + x[i]][p.y + y[i]] = dis[p.x][p.y] + 1;
                    vis[p.x + x[i]][p.y + y[i]] = 1;
                    Q[r++] = new Node(p.x + x[i], p.y + y[i]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void Find(int tx, int ty, int idx) {
        int i, l = 1, r = 0, j;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Dis[i][j] = 60;
            }
        }
        Q[r++] = new Node(tx, ty);
        vis[tx][ty] = 1;
        Dis[tx][ty] = 0;
        while (l <= r) {
            Node p = Q[l++];
            for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                if (check(p.x + x[i], p.y + y[i])) {
                    Dis[p.x + x[i]][p.y + y[i]] = Dis[p.x][p.y] + 1;
                    vis[p.x + x[i]][p.y + y[i]] = 1;
                    if (Dis[p.x + x[i]][p.y + y[i]] < dis[p.x + x[i]][p.y + y[i]]) {
                        Q[r++] = new Node(p.x + x[i], p.y + y[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Dis[i][j] <= t && S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9' && Dis[i][j] <= dis[i][j]) {
                    add(idx, id[i][j] + tot, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int bfs() {
        int i, p, l = 1, r = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n * n * 2; i++) {
            dist[i] = -1;
        }
        dist[st] = 0;
        Q[r++] = new Node(st, 0);
        while (l <= r) {
            Node p = Q[l++];
            for (i = (int) s[p.x].before; i != 0; i = s[i].before) {
                if (s[i].flow > 0) {
                    if (dist[s[i].ed] == -1) {
                        Q[r++] = new Node(s[i].ed, 0);
                        dist[s[i].ed] = dist[p.x] + 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[ed] == -1 ? 0 : 1;
    }

    static void add(int p1, int p2, int p3) {
        s[++k1] = new Bian(p2, fox[p1], p3);
        fox[p1] = k1;
        s[++k1] = new Bian(p1, fox[p2], 0);
        fox[p2] = k1;
    }

    static int dfs(int num, int flow) {
        int i, a, nowans = 0;
        if (num == ed) return flow;
        for (i = (int) s[num].before; i != 0 && flow != 0; i = s[i].before) {
            if (s[i].flow > 0 && dist[s[i].ed] == dist[num] + 1) {
                a = dfs(s[i].ed, Math.min(s[i].flow, flow));
                if (a > 0) {
                    s[i].flow -= a;
                    s[i ^ 1].flow += a;
                    flow -= a;
                    nowans += a;
                }
                if (nowans == 0) {
                    dist[num] = (int) 1e9;
                }
            }
        }
        return nowans;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int j, ans = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            j = dfs(st, (int) 1e9);
            while (j != 0) {
                ans += j;
                j = dfs(st, (int) 1e9);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String[] str = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(str[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(str[1]);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            c[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            S[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int sx = 0; sx < n; sx++) {
            for (int sy = 0; sy < n; sy++) {
                if (c[sx][sy] == 'Z') break;
                if (sy != n) break;
            }
            if (sy != n) break;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                id[i][j] = ++tot;
            }
        }
        st = 2 * tot + 1;
        ed = st + 1;
        Bfs();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (c[i][j] > '0' && c[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(st, id[i][j], c[i][j] - '0');
                    Find(i, j, id[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(id[i][j] + tot, ed, S[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        pw.println(maxflow());
        pw.close();
    }
}
